title: Real World Adoption: Cardano Payments in Vending Machines

ms.promise:
A. DripDropz will have prepared educational content for vending machine operators interested in supporting cryptocurrency payments in their vending machines.
B. Remarc and DripDropz will have prepared target campaign initiatives that will be executed to convert existing vending machine owners into supporting cryptocurrency payments in their vending machines.
ms.criteria:
A. Reviewers can review a spreadsheet listing each DripDropz (branding TBA) onboarding collateral item that will be used to educate and onboard vending machine owners. Reviewers can also review each DripDropz (branding TBA) onboarding collateral item that will be used for educating and onboarding merchants to accept cryptocurrency. This collateral is specific to DripDropz onboarding payment customers to the new DripDropz (branding TBA) payments platform and will include both video and written content.
B. Reviewers can review a spreadsheet listing each campaign initiative and web funnel targete
ms.report:
A.
Output: riverArk has prepared educational content for vending machine operators interested in supporting cryptocurrency payments in their vending machines. 31 onboarding collateral items covering the operator journey from awareness through evaluation, account and machine onboarding, and post-install support. 6 items are video and 25 are written.
Acceptance criteria: Reviewers can review a spreadsheet listing each onboarding collateral item used to educate and onboard vending machine owners, and can also review each collateral item itself. The collateral is specific to onboarding payment customers to the riverArk payments platform and includes both video and written content.

B.
Output: riverArk and Remarc have prepared 13 target campaign initiatives to convert existing vending machine owners into supporting cryptocurrency payments in their vending machines, spanning trade show, paid, email, direct outreach and web funnel channels. Every initiative has a destination, and 10 operator web funnel pages have been produced and staged.
Acceptance criteria: Reviewers can review a spreadsheet listing each campaign initiative and web funnel targeted at onboarding existing vending machine owners, with fields for expected campaign start and expected duration,
